mapper.sql: select a.article_id, a.article_code, a.legacy_path, a.category_id, a.draft_revision_id, a.published_revision_id, a.previous_published_revision_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, c.category_code, c.category_name, coalesce(d.title, p.title) as title, coalesce(d.top_flag, p.top_flag, '0') as top_flag from site_article a left join site_article_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id left join site_article_revision d on d.revision_id = a.draft_revision_id left join site_article_revision p on p.revision_id = a.published_revision_id

select revision_id, article_id, revision_no, revision_state, title, summary, body_html, seo_json, top_flag, content_hash, published_at, published_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from site_article_revision
mapper.select: a.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(d.title, p.title) like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and c.category_code = #{categoryCode} order by coalesce(d.top_flag, p.top_flag, '0') desc, coalesce(d.published_at, p.published_at) desc, a.article_id desc
where a.article_id = #{articleId} and a.del_flag = '0' for update
select category_id from site_article_category where category_code = #{categoryCode} and enabled_flag = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into site_article (article_code, legacy_path, category_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{articleCode}, #{legacyPath}, #{categoryId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_article set article_code=#{articleCode}, legacy_path=#{legacyPath}, category_id=#{categoryId}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where article_id=#{articleId} and del_flag='0'

update site_article set draft_revision_id=#{draftRevisionId}, published_revision_id=#{publishedRevisionId}, previous_published_revision_id=#{previousPublishedRevisionId}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where article_id=#{articleId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: where article_id=#{articleId} and revision_state='DRAFT' order by revision_no desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(revision_no), 0) + 1 from site_article_revision where article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_article_revision (article_id, revision_no, revision_state, title, summary, body_html, seo_json, top_flag, content_hash, published_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{articleId}, #{revisionNo}, #{revisionState}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{bodyHtml}, #{seoJson}, #{topFlag}, #{contentHash}, #{publishedAt}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_article_revision set title=#{title}, summary=#{summary}, body_html=#{bodyHtml}, seo_json=#{seoJson}, top_flag=#{topFlag}, content_hash=#{contentHash}, published_at=#{publishedAt}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where revision_id=#{revisionId} and revision_state='DRAFT'

update site_article_revision set revision_state=#{revisionState}, published_at=case when #{revisionState}='PUBLISHED' then coalesce(published_at, sysdate()) else published_at end, published_by=case when #{revisionState}='PUBLISHED' then #{publishedBy} else published_by end where revision_id=#{revisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_publish_audit (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, action_type, from_revision_id, to_revision_id, operator, reason) values ('ARTICLE', #{aggregateId}, #{actionType}, #{fromRevisionId}, #{toRevisionId}, #{operator}, #{reason})
